sources.title: Sify Data Center in Noida location page (Noida 01 and Noida 02)
sources.summary: Sify's Noida data-centre page, in its version of 29 September 2026, opens: 'Accelerate AI innovation and digital transformation with Sify's Noida 02 Data Center Campus, offering scalable, resilient, and sustainable infrastructure with 130+ MW of IT capacity, carrier-neutral connectivity, cloud adjacency, and colocation services.' It says Sify 'added Noida 02 campus within 1KM' of Noida 01 (Plot B7, Sector 132), that 'Sify has its second Hyperscale data center campus in Delhi, NCR-Noida 02' with 25.92 MW IT power and a dedicated on-premise 220 kV substation, and that Noida 02 'is interconnected with Noida 01 through metro Cross Connects'; other sentences remain in the future tense ('will be interconnected', 'Proposed ISPs').
sources.date_semantics: The page's article:modified_time is 2026-09-29T12:17:38Z, matching the page-sitemap lastmod (local sify-page-sitemap.xml). The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 12 July 2026, which carries the preceding version (modified 2026-07-09) without the opening Noida 02 sentence, and above by the Internet Archive copy of 1 October 2026 and the live capture of 26 October 2026, which both carry this version. published_at records the modification day; the present-tense statements are used as a 29 September 2026 operator observation that the Noida 02 campus is in service. They do not say how much of the campus is built, so the existing partially-operational code is kept; 25.92 MW and 130+ MW are stated figures, not measured load.

sources.title: Equinix invierte US$28 millones para ampliar la capacidad de su centro de datos BG2 en Bogotá (Equinix press release, 20 August 2026)
sources.summary: Equinix press release datelined 'BOGOTÁ, Colombia, August 20, 2026'. Equinix announces the expansion of 'su centro de datos International Business Exchange (IBX) BG2, en Bogotá' with an additional US$28 million and 550 new cabinets, 'duplicando la capacidad del sitio'. It states: 'BG2 fue anunciado originalmente en 2022 con una inversión de US$45 millones. La primera fase de la instalación incorporó 550 gabinetes y esta nueva ampliación representa la segunda fase del proyecto, duplicando efectivamente la capacidad disponible en el sitio', and that through Equinix's Bogotá facilities customers can reach low-latency international routes, including MI1 in Miami. Equinix Americas, LATAM and Chile/Colombia/Peru executives are quoted. It gives no opening date for the first phase, no MW figure, no construction schedule and no address.
sources.date_semantics: Press release dated 20 August 2026 (dateline; the newsroom URL carries the same date and the Equinix Latin America press-release list captured on 26 October 2026 dates it Aug 20, 2026). Its present-tense description of BG2 as Equinix's existing IBX data centre whose first phase incorporated 550 cabinets, with capacity 'disponible en el sitio' that the expansion will double, is used as a publication-normalised operating observation of the first phase on 20 August 2026. It is not an inspection day, an opening date or a commissioning milestone; the first phase's opening date is not stated. This capture (26 October 2026) differs in bytes from the 16 October capture behind the existing Phase 2 record only in per-request script nonces; the extracted text is identical.
